headline: Commodities chronicle: Growing demand for biofuels and El Niño risks push palm oil prices higher
summary: Palm oil prices are rising, driven by growing demand for biofuels. The rise also reflects concerns about the effects of the El Niño climate phenomenon.
why: Palm oil is one of the world's most traded vegetable oils, used in food and biodiesel. Its prices are sensitive to weather in producing countries and to biofuel mandates.
